tagline: Central Headquarters, Triveni Sangam Akhand Mahaprasad, Bade Hanuman Ji Seva & Slum Pathshalas
summary: Headquarters of Sarva Samarpit Sewa Sansthan located at Shree Bade Hanuman Ji Temple Marg, Bandhwa, Prayagraj. Serving 3,500+ daily hot satvik meals, operating free evening tuition centers for 450+ slum children, and managing large-scale pilgrim welfare camps during Magh Mela and Mahakumbh.
prog1Title: 24/7 Akhand Mahaprasad Langar at Bade Hanuman Ji
prog1Desc: Operating continuous food distribution on Sangam Marg and temple premises. Freshly prepared hot meals served to arriving sadhus, ascetics, devotees, and indigent families daily.
prog2Desc: Free primary coaching, NCERT textbooks, notebooks, school bags, and winter shoes for children of boatmen, daily-wage laborers, and local slum clusters in Prayagraj.
prog3Title: Magh Mela & Mahakumbh 24/7 Pilgrim Relief Camp
prog3Desc: Emergency medical assistance, lost & found helpdesk, warm clothing distribution, and mass drinking water stalls across the Sangam sandy tracts during winter cold waves.
img1Cap: Daily hot satvik food seva at Shree Bade Hanuman Ji Mandir Marg, Prayagraj

faq1Q: Where is Sarva Samarpit Sewa Sansthan located in Prayagraj?
faq1A: The registered headquarters is situated at Shree Bade Hanuman Ji Temple Marg, Bandhwa, Prayagraj - 211006, directly adjacent to the holy Triveni Sangam.
faq2Q: How can I sponsor daily Langar or Bhandara in Prayagraj?
faq2A: You can sponsor full-day, half-day, or special occasion Mahaprasad langars online through our official donation portal. All donations receive instant 80G tax receipts.

prog1Title: Kashi Ghat Annapurna Food Packet Seva
prog1Desc: Distribution of nutritious, hygienically packed hot meals to sadhus, ascetics, and vulnerable pilgrims resting on Varanasi ghats and temple corridors.
prog2Title: Support for Destitute Elders & Mataji Shelters
prog2Desc: Regular supply of dry grocery kits, medical health checkups, walking sticks, and warm bedding to elderly widows and homeless senior citizens across Varanasi.
prog3Desc: Supporting students of traditional Vedic pathshalas with study materials, uniforms, daily dietary assistance, and competitive educational support.
img1Cap: Annapurna Prasad packets distributed to sadhus and pilgrims along Kashi ghats

faq1Q: Does Sarva Samarpit Sewa Sansthan operate daily in Varanasi?
faq1A: Yes, our volunteer teams coordinate daily food packet distribution and seasonal relief across Varanasi ghats and inner temple alleys.
faq2Q: Are donations made for Varanasi seva eligible for Section 80G tax exemption?
faq2A: Yes, all donations qualify for 50% income tax exemption under Section 80G (Approval No. AABTS8923RF20214) with instant electronic 80G receipts.

prog2Desc: Regular voluntary cleaning drives along Saryu Ghats, assisting elderly pilgrims during snan, and maintaining emergency medical first-aid posts.
prog3Desc: Free evening education centers in rural pockets of Ayodhya district, giving uniforms, stationery, and foundational numeracy support to poor children.

faq1Q: Where is the Ayodhya Seva Camp set up?

faq2Q: Can I sponsor food or water daan in Ayodhya in memory of family members?

nameHi: गोरखपुर - पूर्वांचल बाल पोषण एवं प्राथमिक शिक्षा केंद्र
tagline: Rural Malnutrition Relief, Free School Study Kits, Preventive Health & Winter Care

prog1Desc: Delivering milk, boiled eggs/sprouts, iron supplements, and fortified grain mixes to toddlers and young children in vulnerable agricultural villages.
prog2Title: Village School Kit & Vidya Daan Campaign
prog2Desc: Distributing free school bags, notebooks, geometry sets, and raincoats to students in government primary schools across rural Gorakhpur.

faq1A: Our Gorakhpur chapter focuses on tackling rural childhood malnutrition, providing primary school education kits, and organizing preventive health camps.
faq2Q: Can CSR contributions support school kits in Gorakhpur?
faq2A: Yes, corporate and institutional donors can sponsor entire schools or village blocks under our CSR and 80G tax-exempt educational framework.

nameEn: Kanpur (Industrial Belt Labor Welfare & Child Labor Prevention)
nameHi: कानपुर - औद्योगिक श्रम कल्याण एवं बाल श्रम मुक्ति केंद्र
tagline: Daily-Wage Laborer Support, Educational Bridge Courses, Ganga Cleanliness & Health Relief
summary: Focused on the industrial belt of Kanpur. Providing educational bridge courses to pull children out of child labor and into formal schools, distributing ration packages to struggling daily-wage laborers, and organizing environmental cleanliness drives along the Ganga river.
prog1Desc: Operating evening informal learning centers near tannery and mill worker colonies to prepare working children for enrollment into mainstream government schools.
prog2Desc: Setting up community food counters at major labor chowks (unorganized worker gathering points) providing fresh, nutritious meals at zero cost.
prog3Desc: Youth volunteer squads mobilizing regular cleaning drives, tree plantation along the river banks, and public awareness against industrial river pollution.
img1Alt: Kanpur Bridge Schools for Laborers Children

faq1A: We run free community langars at labor chowks, distribute ration kits during industrial layoffs, and run schools to prevent children from entering manual labor.
faq2Q: Are Kanpur donations eligible for instant 80G receipts?
faq2A: Yes, all online and bank donations automatically generate an official 80G tax-exemption receipt for instant download.

nameEn: Mathura-Vrindavan (Braj Bhoomi Gau Seva & Sadhu Annadaan)

tagline: Akhand Gau Seva Ashram, Parikrama Pilgrim Relief, Sadhu Mahaprasad & Destitute Mataji Care
summary: Dedicated to the holy soil of Braj Bhoomi. Operating a loving Gau Seva ashram caring for injured and abandoned cows, serving daily hot satvik meals to parikrama pilgrims and venerable sadhus in Vrindavan and Govardhan, and providing medical support to destitute elderly mothers.

prog3Desc: Operating free camps with chilled drinking water, medical blister care, foot massages for elderly pilgrims, and glucose electrolytes along the 21km parikrama marg.

faq1A: Yes, you can sponsor daily green fodder (Chara Daan), veterinary medicines, or full-day Gaushala meals with 80G tax benefits.
faq2Q: How are destitute mothers assisted in Vrindavan?

nameEn: Jhansi (Bundelkhand Drought Relief & Jal Daan Tankers)

prog3Title: Farmer Family Food Security & Winter Blankets
prog3Desc: Supplying grain bags, pulses, cooking oil, and salt to smallholder and marginal farming households suffering from seasonal crop failure.

faq1A: Jal Daan is our emergency water relief program deploying tractor tankers filled with clean drinking water directly to dry village squares in Bundelkhand.

faq1Q: How does the Sansthan support tribal children in Mirzapur?
faq1A: We operate community learning centers in remote forest villages, providing free bags, stationery, shoes, and daily nutritious meals to tribal children.
faq2Q: Can I donate specifically for Vindhyachal pilgrim or tribal seva?
